global.missing_value_policy: preserve mask/sentinel semantics; no silent imputation; target-specific rules recorded
global.outlier_policy: no outcome-driven trimming; predeclared physical/quality exclusions only
global.ci_method: log-cluster bootstrap; BCa when estimable, percentile fallback declared

d0.historical_reference: T150 + final hidden + historical mask/padding behavior

d2.ood_boundary: reference q99 per metric; OOD_DOMINATED when >=2/4 exceed

D0.precision_or_power: two-sided power=0.80; sensitivity n=1051 for power=0.90

D1.log_cluster_assumption: requires target prevalence/variance and owner SESOI; 5-fold grouping alone is not power

D2.raw_units_required: depends on frozen stratum occupancy after pre-treatment metadata
D2.log_cluster_assumption: same log remains clustered; never coarsen across scenario_family
D2.precision_or_power: minimum operational cell size, not powered effect detection

D3.planning_target: nominal FPR=.05; two-sided Wilson upper 95% CI<=.075
D3.log_cluster_assumption: trials must be independent/effective null units; dependence lowers effective n
